My current inventory spans budget to premium Apple phones: iPhone 5c, iPhone 6 Plus, iPhone XR, iPhone SE 2nd Gen., iPhone 6s Plus, and iPhone 7 Plus. That mix lets me serve both entry-level buyers and higher-budget buyers in one storefront.

Unlocked models consistently look like the easier premium sell because several of my active listings are unlocked: Apple iPhone SE 2nd Gen. (PRODUCT)RED - 128GB (Unlocked), Apple iPhone 6 Plus - 16GB - Gold (Unlocked), Apple iPhone 6s Plus - 128GB - Silver (Unlocked), and Apple iPhone 7 Plus - 128GB - Jet Black (Unlocked).

My operating baseline is backed by a 4.3-star seller signal from 1981 review-like signals, so I can stay direct and process-driven instead of chasing every lead. Buyers usually respond better when I present the listing facts cleanly and keep the terms simple.

For older Apple iPhone 5s units, negotiating too long is usually not worth it because the market already shows cheap alternatives. For stronger unlocked models like the Apple iPhone 6s Plus - 128GB - Silver (Unlocked) at 47495 cents or Apple iPhone SE 2nd Gen. (PRODUCT)RED - 128GB (Unlocked) at 48000 cents, I can hold firmer.

Direct messages that name the exact Apple model, storage, color, and carrier status reduce wasted questions. This matters most on similar-looking iPhone 5s listings where buyers need the distinction between T-Mobile, AT&T, and unlocked devices.

typed_memories.content: Amcrest IP2M-841B at 4995 cents feels like a strong reference point for affordable indoor camera demand, so I use that band when judging other basic home-camera deals.

The Amcrest IP4M-1026B showed a big spread between 7999 cents and 14999 cents, which taught me identical model families can attract very different buyer expectations depending on timing and listing quality.
My inventory has centered on Amcrest security cameras across indoor, outdoor bullet, and dome formats, so I know that category better than general consumer pet cameras.
I am cautious with the TOOGE Pet Camera FHD Pet Indoor Camera because it is priced at 4428 cents but only shows 1 review with a 1.0 rating.
Premium items like the DJI Mavic Pro Platinum at 127138 cents and the Amcrest IP8M-2493EW at 165142 cents require slower, proof-heavy negotiation and less reactive discounting.
Buyers looking at outdoor security gear respond to concrete descriptors like wireless, outdoor, bullet, weatherproof, and dome, while indoor buyers care more about pan/tilt and WiFi.
Short, factual replies work best in this category because most camera buyers want model confirmation, condition, and price without extra chatter.
